title: Purple Dragon Blush
summary: Provides 6 Camp Supplies or can be drunk or thrown.

fields.Drink: Bonus Action. Alcohol imposes disadvantage on Dexterity and Charisma checks for 2 turns.
fields.Throw: Action. Creates a 13 ft radius permanent Alcohol surface. Fire ignites it for 2 turns before it becomes Ash. Cold freezes it for 2 turns before it becomes Water.

changes: Added native BG3 rules using pinned item and linked gameplay sources.
